newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup -USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in light test.
Wk to Date - 104,600 Week Ago - 93,400 Year Ago - 111,800

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,300 head slaughter steers and 200 heifers; 104,600 head confirmed for the week to date, including 28,100 formulated and 2,800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00. Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 63.00.
